This [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] male was the '''King of Falleen''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:King_of_Falleen2.png|thumb|left|150px|Dooku "convinces" the king to lower the shield.]]
In the early stages of the Clone Wars, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led an attack on the Falleen [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|same name]]. [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] infiltrated a temple and defeated the king's four [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. The assault was a diversion, however, allowing [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to also infiltrate the temple undetected. Dooku held his ignited [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to the king's throat demanding he lower the shields surrounding the temple and cede the planet to the Separatist cause.<ref name="Fall" />
